content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: in both windows, a visible error event fires within about 6-8 ms of the Counterparty field receiving focus (61:a65 at 3438 ms after focus at 3431 ms; 98:a104 at 7565 ms after focus at 7557 ms), before any keystroke in that field, so the field appears to be in an error state on arrival; in both sessions the user then moved to Static Data and navigated to counterparty:screen rather than continuing to edit the form.", "fix": "Fix: On the ir swap:screen form, change the Counterparty input so its validation error is not shown on focus; show the error only on blur or on save attempt, and check why the error is already set before the user types.", "cited_event_ids": ["60", "61:a65", "66", "67", "97", "98:a104", "104", "92", "app:21"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The error message text and the validation rule that produced it are not in the events.", "Whether the error clears after input or persists is not visible in the windows.", "The windows show app_action success events later in both sessions (app:23:success, app:28:success, app:17:success, app:22:success, app:36:success), which does not clearly match the insight's 'abandoned without saving' outcome; the save/abandon outcome is taken from the insight facts, not verified here.", "The reason for navigating to Static Data (counterparty:screen) is not stated in the events.", "Only two of the three affected sessions are in the windows; the third session is not verified.", "Whether the Counterparty error is caused by a stale value, a prefilled field, or a rule on focus cannot be determined from the events."]}
